items.source:
This strategy serves as a fallback if no specific server has been detected.
It can also be used with Jakarta EE 10 level servers such as Tomcat 10.1 and
Undertow 2.3 directly, relying on their built-in Jakarta WebSocket 2.1 support.
items.translation: 此策略在检测到特定服务器时作为后备方案。它也可以直接用于 Jakarta EE 10 级别的服务器，例如 Tomcat 10.1 和 Undertow 2.3，并依赖其内置的 Jakarta WebSocket 2.1 支持。

items.source: Exposes the underlying config option on WebSocketContainer.setAsyncSendTimeout(long).
items.translation: 暴露了 WebSocketContainer.setAsyncSendTimeout(long) 的底层配置选项。

items.source: Upgrade to a WebSocket session and handle it with the given handler.
items.translation: 升级为 WebSocket 会话并使用给定的处理器进行处理。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Violeta Georgieva, Rossen Stoyanchev

items.translation: `upgrade` 接口 `RequestUpgradeStrategy` 中

items.source: subProtocol - the selected sub-protocol got the handler
items.translation: subProtocol - 选定的子协议已获取处理器

items.source: handshakeInfoFactory - factory to create HandshakeInfo for the WebSocket session
items.translation: handshakeInfoFactory - 用于为 WebSocket 会话创建 HandshakeInfo 的工厂

items.source: completion Mono<Void> to indicate the outcome of the WebSocket session handling.
items.translation: 完成一个Mono<Void>以指示 WebSocket 会话处理的結果。
